allow: Bash(D=$\(mktemp -d /tmp/tissot-assets.XXXXXX\); BASE="https://yncpifbuhjhfolsngkov.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/images/tissotwook"; for p in "kr/PAGE/5-1.REWARD-bg" "en/PAGE/4-1.REWARD-bg" "kr/PAGE/5-1.REWARD-Default-bg" "en/PAGE/4-1.REWARD-Default-bg"; do n=$\(echo "$p" | tr '/' '_'\); code=$\(curl -s -o "$D/$n.webp" -w "%{http_code}" "$BASE/$p.webp"\); sz=$\(stat -f%z "$D/$n.webp" 2>/dev/null\); echo "$p -> $code ${sz}B"; if [ "$code" = 200 ]; then sips -s format png "$D/$n.webp" --out "$D/$n.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight "$D/$n.png" 2>/dev/null | tail -2 | tr '\\n' ' '; echo; else rm -f "$D/$n.webp"; fi; done; ls "$D"; echo "D=$D")
